_comment: 唯一真源：首页 Latest Update 区块与 /updates/ 页都必须读本文件，严禁在 page.tsx 里写死数组。updates[0] 即首页 C 位。currentVersion 与 lastUpdated 必须与 game.config.json 的 game 字段一致（audit-updates.mjs 会比对）。

updates.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave launches worldwide (v1.0.1)
updates.headline: Launch-day patch plus four free collaboration weapons
updates.description: The game released on Nintendo Switch 2 on September 17, 2026 at $69.99 digital / $79.99 physical, alongside version 1.0.1 and a free update that adds four collaboration weapons. This is the version baseline every page on this site is written against.
